# AMENDED (t141 Card A): the disclosure carrier is the LIVE regenerated
    # criterion doc (docs/criteria/security_ops_verification.md), the t41
    # generator's own product - never the frozen closed card. The generator
    # cannot regenerate the doc without its rows/loops PASS lines matching its
    # pins, so this interlock is self-maintaining (the t131 live-carrier pattern).
    carrier = read_text(os.path.join(root, CARRIER_REL))

    m_loop_carrier = re.search(r"^REGISTER_DATA_ROWS ([0-9]+) PASS$", carrier, re.M)

        return problems + ["the live carrier %s carries no 'REPORT_ROWS <rows> PASS' "
                           "line - the regenerated criterion doc is the named disclosure "
                           "carrier; without that line the pinned rows are not disclosed "
                           "in machine-checkable form" % CARRIER_REL], evidence
    if m_rows_carrier.group(1) != pinned_rows:
        problems.append("the live carrier discloses REPORT_ROWS %s but the generator pins "
                        "%r - the doc is stale against its own generator (a regeneration "
                        "that did not re-pin, or a re-pin that did not regenerate)"
                        % (m_rows_carrier.group(1), pinned_rows))
    if not m_loop_carrier:
        problems.append("the live carrier carries no 'REGISTER_DATA_ROWS <n> PASS' line - "
                        "the loop-ids disclosure moved out of the frozen closed card and "
                        "must be re-derivable from the carrier")

        problems.append("the live carrier discloses REGISTER_DATA_ROWS %s but the generator "

                        "PASS, matching the generator pins extracted live (the t131-class "
                        "live named carrier; the frozen closed card is never the target)"
